sparql_query:
SELECT
  ?sample
  ?observatory
  ?event

  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid
    ?sname
  ?lsuval
  ?ssuval
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample .
  # link event
  ?sample sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory
  ?event sampl:linkedToObservatory ?observatory .
  # Optional filters
  # name of observatory
  # depth filter

  # Marine Region (ID)
  ?observatory emobon:marineRegion ?mrgid . 
  FILTER regex(str(?mrgid), "http://marineregions.org/mrgid/17355") .
  # marineregion name
  ?observatory emopb:marineRegionName ?mrgn . 
  ?mrgn onto:fts ("Norwegian Sea~5") .
  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin . 

  # dateTime event
  FILTER(?datetime_begin >= "2022-02-07T18:01:56Z"^^xsd:date) .
  FILTER(?datetime_begin <= "2025-08-29T21:35:43Z"^^xsd:date) .
  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .
    
  ?taxonid dct:scientificName ?sname .
  ?sname onto:fts ("Synechococcus_sp._RCC307~5") .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:lsuRNA ?lsuval .
    FILTER(?lsuval >= 91) . 
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:ssuRNA ?ssuval .
    FILTER(?ssuval >= 91) .   
  }
  FILTER(BOUND(?lsuval) || BOUND(?ssuval))
}

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX onto: <http://www.ontotext.com/>
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT
  ?sample
  ?observatory
  ?event
  
  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid
    ?sname
  ?lsuval
  ?ssuval
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample .
  # link event
  ?sample sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory
  ?event sampl:linkedToObservatory ?observatory .
  # Optional filters
  # name of observatory
  
  ?observatory emobon:observatoryId ?observatory_id .
  ?observatory_id onto:fts ("ESC68N~5 PiEGetxo~5 MBAL4~5") .# depth filter
  
  ?observatory emobon:waterColumnDepth/qudt:numericValue ?depth_value .
  FILTER(?depth_value > 235) .
  # Marine Region (ID)
  ?observatory emobon:marineRegion ?mrgid . 
  FILTER regex(str(?mrgid), "http://marineregions.org/mrgid/1906") .
  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin . 
  
  # dateTime event
  FILTER(?datetime_begin >= "2022-08-29T12:59:29Z"^^xsd:date) .
  FILTER(?datetime_begin <= "2022-10-03T01:31:55Z"^^xsd:date) .
  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .
      
  ?taxonid dct:scientificName ?sname .
  ?sname onto:fts ("Prymnesiaceae~5") .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:lsuRNA ?lsuval .
    FILTER(?lsuval >= 23) . 
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:ssuRNA ?ssuval .
    FILTER(?ssuval >= 23) .  
  }
  FILTER(BOUND(?lsuval) || BOUND(?ssuval))
}

  ?result_silicate
  ?value_silicate
  ?label_pressure
  ?result_pressure

  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid

  ?rank

  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin .

  FILTER(?datetime_begin >= "2024-09-30T08:35:28Z"^^xsd:date) .
  FILTER(?datetime_begin <= "2025-03-09T18:57:44Z"^^xsd:date) .
  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .
      
  ?taxonid dct:scientificName ?sname .
  ?sname onto:fts ("Croceitalea~5") .
  ?taxonid dct:taxonRank ?rank .
  ?rank onto:fts ("class~5") .
  ?observations a sosa:Observation .

PREFIX prod: <https://data.emobon.embrc.eu/ns/product#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX emobon: <https://data.emobon.embrc.eu/ns/core#>
PREFIX sampl: <https://data.emobon.embrc.eu/ns/sampling#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX onto: <http://www.ontotext.com/
PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#
SELECT
  ?sample
  ?observatory
  ?event

  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid

  ?lsuval
  ?ssuval
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample .
  # link event
  ?sample sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory
  ?event sampl:linkedToObservatory ?observatory .
  # Optional filters
  # name of observatory

  ?observatory emobon:observatoryId ?observatory_id .
  ?observatory_id onto:fts ("IUIEilat~5 HCMR-1~5 OOB~5") .# depth filter

  # marineregion name
  ?observatory emobon:marineRegionName ?mrgn . 
  ?mrgn onto:fts ("Porto Valley~5") .
  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin . 

  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:lsuRNA ?lsuval .
    FILTER(?lsuval >= 45) . 
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:ssuRNA ?ssuval .
    FILTER(?ssuval >= 45) . 
  }
  FILTER(BOUND(?lsuval) || BOUND(?ssuval))
}

SELECT

  ?rank onto:fts ("species~5") .
}

question: What are the samples, their associated observatories and events that were observed during the period between October 2022 to December 2025 in Swedish part of Baltic Sea at depth greater than or equal to 861 meters where Nitrospinaceae is identified with kingdom taxonomic rank? Also provide details about measurements for seawater temperature below 36 degrees Celsius and salinity values under 86 PSU.

sparql_query:
SELECT
  ?sample
  ?observatory
  ?event

  ?observations

  ?label_nitrite
  ?result_nitrite
  ?value_nitrite
  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid
    ?sname
  ?rank
  ?lsuval
  ?ssuval
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample ;
      				# link event
        sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory

  # name of observatory
  # depth filter

  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin .

  FILTER ( ?datetime_begin >= "2022-02-20T04:57:57Z"^^xsd:date ) .
  FILTER ( ?datetime_begin <= "2024-03-22T13:10:47Z"^^xsd:date ) .
  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation ;

  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .
       
  ?taxonid dct:scientificName ?sname .
  ?sname onto:fts ( "Cellvibrionaceae~5" ) .
  ?rank onto:fts ( "phylum~5" ) .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:lsuRNA ?lsuval .
      	FILTER( ?lsuval >= 45 ) . 
  }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:ssuRNA ?ssuval .
        	FILTER( ?ssuval >= 45 ) .   
  } 
  FILTER ( BOUND(?lsuval) || BOUND(?ssuval))
  ?observations a sosa:Observation;

  ?label_nitrite onto:fts " nitrite ~5 " .
  ?observations sosa:hasResult ?result_nitrite .

  FILTER (?value_nitrite <=62)

SELECT
  ?sample
  ?observatory
  ?event

  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid
    ?sname
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample .
  # link event
  ?sample sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory
  ?event sampl:linkedToObservatory ?observatory .

  # name of observatory

  ?observatory emobon:observatoryId ?observatory_id .
  ?observatory_id onto:fts ("MBAL4~5 PiEGetxo~5") .# depth filter

  ?observatory emobon:waterColumnDepth/qudt:numericValue ?depth_value .
  FILTER(?depth_value > 983) .
  # marineregion name
  ?observatory emobon:marineRegionName ?mrgn . 
  ?mrgn onto:fsr ("Crete Sea~5") .
  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin . 

  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .
    
  ?taxonid dct:scientificName ?sname .
  ?sname onto:fts ("Bacillales~5") .
}
question: What samples, observatories, events, taxonannotations, taxonids, and snames are associated with the MBAL4 or PiEGetxo observatories located in Crete Sea region at depths greater than 983 meters where Bacillales were identified?

  ?sample

  ?event

  ?taxonannotation
  ?taxonid

  ?lsuval
  ?ssuval
WHERE {
  ?sample a sosa:Sample .
  # link event
  ?sample sosa:isResultOf ?event .
  # link observatory
  ?event sampl:linkedToObservatory ?observatory .
  # Optional filters
  # name of observatory
  # depth filter

  ?event prov:startedAtTime ?datetime_begin . 

  # linking between taxon annotations and sample
  ?taxonannotation a prod:TaxonomicAnnotation .
  ?taxonannotation prod:ofSample ?sample .
  ?taxonannotation dct:identifier ?taxonid .

  OPTIONAL {
    ?taxonannotation prod:lsuRNA ?lsuval .

  OPTIONAL {

    FILTER(?ssuval >= 23) .

  FILTER(BOUND(?lsuval) || BOUND(?ssuval))
}
